A full-body medium-wide shot at eye level, from the front, of the woman from <Picture 1> standing on a seamless light-grey studio floor in front of a matching grey backdrop. Preserve the same facial identity, hairstyle, costume colours and boots shown in <Picture 1> throughout. She begins standing upright with her feet together and her arms relaxed at her sides. Then she performs a powerful, graceful and dynamic full spin on the spot, an elegant, energetic and fluid turn that looks smooth, sharp, confident and stylish, beautifully controlled and impressive from start to finish, with a strong, expressive and dramatic feeling of movement and a polished, athletic quality throughout the whole spin. pair_check.method: python: len(field.split()) == wc -w; shared sentences are the same Python string objects inserted into both arms, asserted present verbatim in both

self_check_notes: i2va: skill gives no fixed count ('shrink when a reference exists'); this plan targets 150-250 words, both arms equal.
single shot: no [Shot 2], no timestamps by design (shot structure is NOT the variable; the earlier §11 trial confounded it).
'hair' appears in B's inertia clause and the shared appearance sentence: B therefore has 2 'hair' hits; this is part of element #6/#8 (inertia), not an appearance restatement.
light/foreground: shared, so §10.8/8b pass equally ('in front of').
rater_brief: A woman on a grey studio floor should do one full turn on the spot and end standing still, feet apart, arms down.

objective.end_settle_residual_motion: ffmpeg -sseof -1 -i <code>.mp4 -vf "tblend=all_mode=difference,signalstats,metadata=print:key=lavfi.signalstats.YAVG" -f null - 2>&1 | grep YAVG  -> mean YAVG over last 1 s (lower = more still)
objective.scene_cuts: ffmpeg -i <code>.mp4 -vf "select='gt(scene,0.3)',showinfo" -f null - 2>&1 | grep -o 'pts_time:[0-9.]*'  (threshold 0.3 primary; also log 0.2 and 0.4)  (expect 0; any cut = structural failure, log it)

rubric.scale_note: 0 = absent/failed, 1 = partial/ambiguous, 2 = clearly present. Score each clip independently; never compare two clips side by side before all scores are written.

artifact.0: severe: limb/face melt, body splits, object morphs

completion.0: no recognisable full turn (partial twist, sway, or different action)
completion.1: turn happens but under/over-rotated (>45 deg off) or interrupted
completion.2: one clear full turn ending facing forward

settle.0: still moving or drifting in the last 1 s
settle.1: stops but wobbles / shifts feet in the last 1 s
settle.2: planted and still for the last >= 0.7 s

legibility.0: body mush: limbs blur/merge during the turn

secondary_follow_through.0: hair/costume frozen or self-animating against motion
secondary_follow_through.1: moves but timing unrelated to the turn
secondary_follow_through.2: lags the body and settles after it

rubric.composite: completion + settle + legibility + artifact (0-8); follow_through reported separately

decision.promote_B: B composite > A composite in 3/3 seeds, OR 2/3 with the third tied; AND B residual motion (last 1 s YAVG) not higher than A in >= 2/3 seeds -> mark action-choreography.md §11 '本機先導實測 (n=3, 0.5MP, i2va 6s)'.
decision.demote: A composite > B in >= 2/3 seeds with none reversed -> §11 back to '方法主張，先導實測未支持', log decision in memory.md.
decision.inconclusive: anything else -> rerun seeds 1004-1006 before deciding; do not edit references/.
decision.resolution_limited: if both arms score legibility 0 in the same seed, mark that seed resolution-limited and exclude it.

independent_verification.computed_by: freeze_plans.py from the exact strings written
